summary: The red-box criterion 'Differs from surrounding moles' is not encoded in either the mole check_for task or the Urgent priority rule, so one of the six same-week referral criteria is silently lost. 'Bleeds easily' encodes a patient-level bleeding tendency rather than a mole that bleeds, and 'Rough skin' / 'Pain of skin' encode general skin findings rather than properties of the lump, which widens the warts and boil rules. The acne rule's or-of-four fires probable Acne on any single pustule or skin nodule, broader than the page's combined picture; all other conditions and diagnoses trace cleanly to the page, with several qualifiers (skin-coloured, pearly, doughy, mobile, purulent) dropped for lack of SNOMED terms.
